tasks.make-miner.title: Build a basic miner
guide.map.title: Move and zoom the map
guide.map.steps:
Drag the map with the left or middle mouse button. On touch, drag with one finger or pinch with two fingers.
Use the mouse wheel or the +/− buttons to zoom. Select ◎ to return to the factory. With a belt or cable selected, pan with the middle button or two fingers.
guide.gather.title: Gather by hand
guide.gather.steps:
Hold an available ore deposit on the map. You can also tap it and hold “Hold to gather” in Operate. With the keyboard, focus that control and hold Space or Enter.
A full bar yields one item. Keep holding to repeat. Release, pan or pinch to clear the unfinished cycle.
guide.build.title: Place and rotate a building
guide.build.steps:
Select a device in Build → Buildings. Tap the map for a preview, tap another tile to move it, then tap the preview to build. Adjust the placement or requirements if the preview turns red.
Hold the preview for about 0.35 seconds, then drag in the desired direction to turn it. You can also use the rotate button or scroll while holding the left mouse button.
Select the same icon again, use Cancel on the construction bar, or right-click to cancel the preview.
guide.miner.title: Check mining progress and output
guide.miner.steps:
Select a placed miner to open Operate and see its mining progress and output slot.
A basic miner stores ore in that slot. Take some ore out when it fills up so mining can resume.
guide.slots.title: Load, take and adjust quantities
guide.slots.steps:
Select a device to open its slots in Operate. Drag a matching material from the top bar into an input slot. Drag manually removable output, unused inputs or belt cargo back to the matching top-bar slot. You can also select the source, then the destination.
Use the wheel while dragging, or select a source and scroll while pointing at that same slot. On touch, hold a slot for about 0.4 seconds, then swipe left to take less or right to take more. Move up or down to continue dragging, or release and drag again.
Hover or tap a slot to check its quantity, capacity and available actions. Select a stack of multiple items to enter an exact amount in its summary.
guide.handwork.title: Make structural plates by hand
guide.handwork.steps:
Open Operate → Handcraft and expand “Structural plate ×1”. Materials shown in red are missing from your inventory.
Once you have the materials, hold the craft button until the bar fills. Keep holding to craft again. You can also focus the button and hold Space or Enter.
guide.belt.title: Plan and drag belts
guide.belt.steps:
Select the basic belt in Build → Buildings → Logistics. Tap the map for a preview, then tap the preview to lock the start. Tap another point to route there, tap an earlier draft tile to go back, then tap the end again to build.
You can also press briefly and drag at once to draw the route. Hold a preview before dragging to turn it. When you use a device with an input as the endpoint, the belt stops in front of it. Tap the device again to confirm.
Run the line from a gold outward arrow toward the receiving device. For direction-sensitive inputs, align it with the cyan inward arrow. After crossings unlock, belts can pass across perpendicular lines. Until then, routes go around existing belts.
guide.power.title: Connect and inspect power
guide.power.steps:
Select cable in Build → Buildings → Power. Select the generator and the device to power, review the route and cost, then tap the end again or use Confirm.
A generator needs fuel. Select a device in Operate to inspect its input and actual power use. Use Power to review grids and find devices without enough power.
guide.orbit.title: Launch and run a daylight trial
guide.orbit.steps:
Select a ground station in Build and place it at Dawnport’s reserved site. Connect power, load materials from the device inspector, then use the launch controls in Orbit.
After launch, use Orbit to check the window, power and reserves. Supply enough calibration cores and power before starting the trial.
tutorial.gather.title: Gather the first iron ore
tutorial.gather.goal: Gather one piece from the exposed iron deposit in view.
tutorial.miner.title: Build a basic miner
tutorial.miner.goal: Collect enough iron ore and place a basic miner on a deposit. Materials are spent when you confirm.
tutorial.miner.ready: A packed miner is ready to place.
tutorial.mining.title: Wait for the miner’s first ore
tutorial.mining.goal: Select the miner to check its progress. The first piece of ore appears in its output slot. If the miner was removed, build another on an iron deposit.
tutorial.collect.title: Take ore from the miner
tutorial.collect.goal: Select the miner and move ore from its output slot to the top-bar iron ore slot.
tutorial.handwork.title: Handcraft a structural plate
tutorial.handwork.goal: Open Operate → Handcraft, expand “Structural plate ×1”, and hold the craft button to turn one iron ore into a plate.
tutorial.bench.title: Build a press
tutorial.bench.goal: Prepare the materials and select the press in Build. Leave space for loading and unloading.
tutorial.feed.title: Load the press
tutorial.feed.goal: Select the press and put iron ore into its input slot. You can load several pieces up to the slot capacity. Rebuild the press if it was removed.
tutorial.working.title: Make a plate with the press
tutorial.working.goal: Wait for one production cycle. Check progress and output in Operate, and add ore if the input is empty.
tutorial.depot.title: Deliver a plate into a depot
tutorial.depot.goal: Place a depot from Build. Run a belt from the press output to the depot, then load the press with ore. The first automatic delivery advances the task.
tutorial.drill.title: Set up industrial mining
tutorial.drill.goal: Select an industrial miner in Build and place it on another iron deposit.
tutorial.power.title: Power the industrial miner
tutorial.power.goal: Build a generator, gather fuel by hand and load its input. Connect it to the iron drill with cable and wait for the drill to produce ore.
tutorial.silica.title: Find material for lenses
tutorial.silica.goal: Find the newly revealed silica deposit and gather one piece.
tutorial.optics.title: Grind the first lens
tutorial.optics.goal: Build and power a grinder. Load two pieces of silica and wait for a lens in the output.
tutorial.assemble.title: Assemble the trial mirror
tutorial.assemble.goal: Build and power a mirror assembler. Put two plates and one lens into their respective slots.
tutorial.launch.title: Launch the trial mirror
tutorial.launch.goal: Load Dawnport’s ground station with three mirror modules and five fuel. Connect power, then launch from Orbit.
tutorial.tracking.title: Run Dawnport’s first daylight trial
tutorial.tracking.goal: Build and power a calibrator to supply the ground station. Review the power and window requirements in Orbit before starting the trial.

guide.manualMaterials.title: Craft ingots and copper wire by hand
guide.manualMaterials.steps:
Collect ore from the basic miner and gather from the nearby copper deposit.
Open Operate → Handcraft and hold the craft button until the batch finishes.
Craft iron and copper ingots at a 2:1 ratio, then make 2 copper wire from 1 copper ingot to unlock power.
guide.connectPower.title: Connect the first power grid
guide.connectPower.steps:
Build a fuel generator and a smelter. Gather fuel and move it into the generator input in Operate.
Lay cable over the footprints of both machines. Extend the same grid to the assembly bench.
guide.chooseRecipe.title: Choose a recipe before supplying inputs
guide.chooseRecipe.steps:
Open the smelter, select iron ingots and feed in iron ore.
Take the ingots and select structural plates in the assembly bench. Feed in two ingots. Both machines require grid power.
Empty the input and output slots and let the current batch finish before switching recipes.
guide.automaticFeed.title: Feed a machine using a short belt
guide.automaticFeed.steps:
Connect a short belt from the smelter outlet to the bench set to structural plates.
Supply iron ore to the smelter. Watch the belt deliver ingots and the bench turn them into plates.
tutorial.manualMaterials.title: Make materials for the first grid
tutorial.manualMaterials.goal: Handcraft iron ingots for the smelter and generator. Craft copper wire to unlock power and cables.
tutorial.connectPower.title: Start power and install an assembly bench
tutorial.connectPower.goal: Build a generator and smelter. Feed fuel into the generator and connect the machines with copper cable. Smelt ingots for an assembly bench.
tutorial.chooseRecipe.title: Make the first batch of structural plates
tutorial.chooseRecipe.goal: Connect the assembly bench, select structural plates and manually feed it two ingots.
tutorial.automaticFeed.title: Automatically feed iron ingots into the bench
tutorial.automaticFeed.goal: Use a belt to carry smelted ingots to the bench and produce the next batch of plates.
tutorial.opticalChain.title: Make lenses from silica
tutorial.opticalChain.goal: Smelt silica ingots, then use assembly benches to make optical blanks and lenses.
tutorial.mirrorChain.title: Splice the first mirror module
tutorial.mirrorChain.goal: Assemble a frame and batch-fire a ferrosilicon billet. Combine them with a lens at a splicing station.
tutorial.calibrationChain.title: Prepare calibration cores for first light
tutorial.calibrationChain.goal: Assemble calibration cores from optical blanks and copper wire. Power the ground station, stock it with cores and start the trial from Orbit.
tutorial.poweredMiner.title: Power an industrial miner
tutorial.poweredMiner.goal: Connect an industrial miner to the grid. Producing iron or copper ore opens silica and the next equipment group.
